title: Beyond a Gaussian Denoiser: Residual Learning of Deep CNN for Image Denoising
grouping: No containers: a single row of layer boxes between two photos; repetition is shown by '...' gaps between identical boxes, and layer roles by fill colour (yellow first, blue middle, orange last).
shapes_depth: Flat tall rectangles with thin coloured outlines and rotated labels ('Conv + ReLU', 'Conv + BN + ReLU', 'Conv'); plain blue arrows between them. The input and output are large square real images of equal height to the boxes: a noisy butterfly photo and a grey noise-only residual.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is singled out; the residual-learning idea is carried by the output being the noise image ('Residual Image') rather than a clean photo.
lesson: Make the learning target visible by drawing the actual output (here a pure-noise residual image) at the same size as the input photo, so the reader sees what the network predicts without reading a word.
notes: No venue printed on the arXiv first page; remembered as IEEE Transactions on Image Processing 2017, so venue = arXiv and year = arXiv preprint year.

arrangement.units: one unframed row: input photo, five layer boxes with ellipsis gaps, output image
arrangement.inputs_as: a large real noisy photo titled 'Noisy Image'
arrangement.shared: none; repeated middle layers are drawn as identical blue boxes separated by '...'

taxonomy.task: blind Gaussian image denoising via residual (noise) prediction
taxonomy.note: architecture 'other' = a plain feed-forward stack of conv layers predicting the residual noise (no skips, no encoder-decoder)

insights.structure: A single unframed row runs from a noisy photo through a yellow first layer, repeated blue middle layers separated by '...', and an orange last layer to an output image.
insights.data: Input and output are both large square images the height of the layer boxes: a real noisy butterfly on the left and a grey pure-noise 'Residual Image' on the right.
insights.emphasis: The residual-learning contribution is shown only by the output being the noise rather than a clean image; the first and last layers are separated from the body by distinct yellow and orange fills.
insights.flow: Straight left-to-right with short blue arrows of equal length; '...' marks where layers are omitted.
insights.avoid: Nothing tells the reader the residual is subtracted from the input to give the clean image, and the layer count/depth is not stated in the drawing.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
